resources.name: FEFF8/9 EXAFS calculation software

resources.name: Open-source MD engine (CP2K or equivalent)

resources.name: OVITO (or custom Voronoi code)
resources.notes: Perform Voronoi tessellation; a custom script using standard libraries is acceptable.
